parsed.title: Research & Automate Your Trading
parsed.snippet:
Blueshift is a versatile platform for research, backtesting, and trading, turning ideas into strategies anytime, anywhere.

Sign Up

## Code & Automate Strategies in Python


Start with sample strategies or develop your own


Backtest over 10+ years of high-quality, minute-level data


Automate Trades in Live Markets


## Platform Features


### Event-driven CEP Engine

Highly flexible and bias-free, seamless from research to live trading.


### State-of-the-art

Scalable, fault-tolerant trading system with comprehensive APIs


### High Quality Data

Built-in curated, bias-free and fully-adjusted datasets covering multiple asset classes.


### Cloud Based

High availability, access from anywhere, anytime

## Learn

To boost to your quant trading quotient, head over to our dedicated learning zone for free courses on python and quant trading topics.
